DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The symptoms of sudden, brief (3-minute) spinning vertigo with nausea and vomiting that resolved spontaneously are classic for BPPV, not gastroenteritis which would not cause vertigo. Do you have any history of recent head trauma or ear infections?
